title: Bag of Bricks-Lilac 06
descriptionHtml:
Lilac — colour 06

A gentle pastel purple that softens everything around it. Lilac does its best work in dusk skies, florals and gradients where you want the colour to shift gradually rather than jump.

Works well with: Lavender 10, Pink 34, Cream 20

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Lilac bricks (colour 06) for Memobrick mosaics. A gentle pastel purple for dusk skies, florals and soft, dreamy colour blends. Resealable bag.
